Chapter 6609: Lonely Wolf

Chapter 6609: Lonely Wolf

The ripple caused time to stop in a sealing effect. However, a radiant glow erupted, revealing a stunning figure within. She broke through the seal with a draconic dao.

“Boom!” Stars shattered from a single hand wave.

“True Emperor Jiu Ning!” An old ancestor recognized her immediately.

“This is beyond the power of an emperor.” Everyone became startled after seeing the explosions of stars.

True Emperor was a forgotten title. They were as strong as the modern Grand Emperors but she took it to the next level.

“It’s the primal level.” A heaven-slayer said: “No, an apex one too just like Grand Preceptor or Light God.”

A whole corner of the star ocean collapsed, revealing a particular treasure. It resembled a pocket watch made from bronze. It contained countless pieces, even an overlord couldn’t create something so special.

“Time Stopper, Li Xingchen’s supreme treasure.” Someone shouted.

“That’s Time Stopper?” Everyone shouted and rushed closer.

“Scram!” True Emperor Jiu Ning domineeringly released her new supreme dao, sweeping through half of space.

The incoming cultivators roared and assumed a defensive stance.

“Rumble!” Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers were sent flying. As for weaker emperors and desolate gods, they vomited blood from serious injuries. The bottom of the pack, unfortunately, was reduced to bloody mists.

However, one person managed to stop her dao with a boundless pillar. Stars shattered around him but he was perfectly fine.

“Fellow Daoist, your new dao is incredible.” He couldn’t help but praise.

Everyone looked over and saw a man in green. His clothing was simple and worn; his hair was casually tied and somewhat messy with a few strands drifting across his forehead. He hadn’t shaved in days and stubble had begun to show on his face, giving him a rugged appearance.

However, his eyes were exceptionally bright like a wolf’s eyes gleaming in the night, visible even from afar.

His posture was tall and upright like a lone pine tree in a snowy landscape, unbending against the elements.

A man like this gave off the impression that he alone could bear the weight of the entire heavens.

“Who is he?” Many big shots in Heaven World didn’t recognize this middle-aged man.

“So powerful.” They saw him blocking the dao unscathed.

“Dugu Yuan.” Jiu Ning recognized him.

“Long time no see, Fellow Daoist.” He cupped his fist, exuding an aura that prevented anyone from getting close.

“That Dugu Yuan?” A few primal ancestors and heaven-slayers heard this name before.

“The only one with this name.” A primal ancestor murmured.

This was a mythical genius who had refused Dingtian’s recruitment to be his disciple.

Dingtian was a supreme immortal with only one equal - Desolate Ancestor. Becoming his disciple was a great honor and fortune.

However, Dugu Yuan was a proud lone wolf who had no intention of kneeling before Dingtian. He was not punished for his pride; his innate talent made up for a lack of guidance.

“Isn’t he in Old World?” An emperor wondered.

“Looks like you are finding an opportunity to break through in Heaven World.” Jiu Ning knew the answer.

“I believe my opportunity is right here and now, would you give it up?” Dugu Yuan gazed at Time Stopper.

“You’re not the only one.” Godstallion appeared.

“Dingtian’s hound wants to play too?” A noble-looking youth strolled through space with a crystalline glow, making him sparkle like a star.

The most remarkable thing about him was a gauntlet in his right hand, seemingly made from divine leather.

Despite his dazzling and ethereal appearance, all eyes were drawn to that hand.
